title: Business Central Trivia Recap: October 19–23, 2026
summary: A weekly Business Central trivia event recap from October 19-23, 2026 showing that players achieved a 63% correct answer rate across 250 questions. The recap identifies the hardest categories (Keyboard Shortcuts, Subscription Billing, Fixed Assets) and easiest (BC Today & Trivia, Navigation, Setup), along with a new auto-refresh feature for the leaderboard.
key_points: 63% correct answer rate across 250 trivia questions with small participation but high engagement
Keyboard Shortcuts was the hardest category at 33% correct, down significantly from 54% the previous week
Fixed Assets remained challenging for participants, appearing in bottom three difficulty categories two weeks running
New auto-refresh feature added to the leaderboard for real-time standings updates
